name: Text-to-UI Cross-Source Mapping Registry
purpose: Single editable relationship layer between HTML contracts, design Tokens, Pixso Variables/Styles, Pixso Components, and external/native component libraries.

policy.editSurface: The committed source of truth is profiles[].tokenMappings, profiles[].semanticTokenMappings, profiles[].runtimeSemanticAliases, profiles[].semanticColorMappings, profiles[].styleMappings, profiles[].componentMappings, profiles[].endpointComponentMappings, and profiles[].nativeSourceMappings here. The full runtime semantic index is generated from semanticTokenMappings plus runtimeSemanticAliases. An Obsidian workbook pending queue may be applied only through scripts/sync-obsidian-mapping-edits.mjs.

identity.htmlToken: canonical CSS variable or semantic role

policy.guidPolicy: Resolve Pixso document and node GUIDs at runtime; never persist GUIDs in this registry.
policy.candidatePolicy: Same-family candidates are visual/source references only, never identity aliases.
policy.projectionPolicy: Existing token/component maps remain generated projections and compatibility inputs; they must be checked against this registry before delivery.
